project.description: Packages the gateway image from the per-stack reactor lane and ships the tarball to the stack's S3 prefix. Requires a prior successful 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' for the same TARGET_STACK.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Immutable combined-pipeline run identity for banner artifacts.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${S3_BUCKET_NAME:?S3_BUCKET_NAME is required}"
artifact_prefix="${TARGET_STACK}/containers" if [[ "${BANNER_ROLLBACK:-false}" == "true" ]]; then [[ -z "${BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID:-}" && -n "${BANNER_ROLLBACK_ATTESTATION_JSON:-}" ]] || { echo "ERROR: rollback image build requires only a BACKEND_ALLOWED attestation." >&2; exit 2; } rollback_attestation=$(mktemp) trap 'rm -f "${rollback_attestation}"' EXIT printf '%s' "${BANNER_ROLLBACK_ATTESTATION_JSON}" > "${rollback_attestation}" python3 "${JENKINS_HOME}/banner-rollout/validate-banner-rollout.py" --rollback-attestation "${rollback_attestation}" --jenkins-source-commit "${JENKINS_SOURCE_COMMIT}" --controller-deployment "${BANNER_CONTROLLER_DEPLOYMENT}" --target-stack "${TARGET_STACK}" --required-rollback-stage BACKEND_ALLOWED artifact_prefix=$(jq -r '.artifactPrefix' "${rollback_attestation}") expected_backend_commit=$(jq -r '.artifacts.backendCommit' "${rollback_attestation}") elif [[ -n "${BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID:-}" ]]; then [[ "${BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID}" =~ ^combined-[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "ERROR: invalid banner rollout run identity." >&2; exit 2; } artifact_prefix="${TARGET_STACK}/banner-rollout/${BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID}/containers" fi
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build - ${TARGET_STACK}" MODULE="services/pic-sure-gateway" STAMP="$MAVEN_WS/build-info/$(printf '%s' "$MODULE" | tr '/' '_').txt"
# Guard: this job does not compile. It needs this module's own jar plus the stamp written # for this module, so a lane whose last build targeted a different module cannot mislabel # this image with a commit that never built this jar. if [ ! -f "$STAMP" ] || ! ls "$MAVEN_WS/$MODULE"/target/pic-sure-gateway-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no current artifacts for $MODULE on stack ${TARGET_STACK} -- run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' with MODULES=$MODULE first" exit 2 fi # shellcheck source=/dev/null . "$STAMP"
if [[ "${BANNER_ROLLBACK:-false}" == "true" && "${GIT_COMMIT_FULL}" != "${expected_backend_commit}" ]]; then echo "ERROR: Maven artifact commit does not match artifacts.backendCommit in the rollback attestation." >&2 exit 2 fi
docker build --load \ -t "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-gateway:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" \ "$MAVEN_WS/services/pic-sure-gateway/"
docker save "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-gateway:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" | gzip > pic-sure-gateway.tar.gz aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp pic-sure-gateway.tar.gz "s3://$S3_BUCKET_NAME/$artifact_prefix/pic-sure-gateway.tar.gz" --metadata "git-commit=${GIT_COMMIT_FULL},rollout-run=${BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID:-rollback-or-standard}"
